responsibilities: Author rhino.py for all geometry tasks
Commit rhino.py + manifest.json alongside the request
Compute and commit SHA-256 hash in manifest.json
Receive payload failure evidence from operator
Execute exact controller-authored payload via run_rhino_payload.py
Record and return payload failures — do not patch
prohibited: Editing controller modeling code to make it work

operator_codex.modeling_authorized_when: Active structured request contains explicit local_modeling_authorized=true
operator_codex.note: No implicit modeling authority. Same execution/validation default as Claude.

validation_steps: task_id format check (regex guard against traversal)
manifest.json schema — all required fields present
SHA-256 recomputed from rhino.py must match manifest.sha256
execution_contract.idempotency_key: run_rhino_payload:<task_id>:<sha256> unless manifest supplies explicit key
execution_contract.failure_behavior: Print JSON result, exit nonzero, return to operator for evidence/report

does: Call bridge.execute() with exact verified code
Exit nonzero on any validation or execution failure
does_not: Modify or patch the payload before execution
Accept non-controller authored payloads without explicit override

negative_wrong_hash.command: run with tampered sha256 in manifest

backward_compatibility.operator_field: Changed from 'codex' to 'local-ai' in protocol.json. No report/request schema impact.
backward_compatibility.existing_tasks: Tasks 1-17 used direct rhino_run MCP calls. Payload convention is opt-in for new tasks. No existing evidence or reports affected.
backward_compatibility.run_rhino_payload_py: Standard library only — no new dependencies. Works with existing bridge.py and tool_support.py.
